scope: Explicit source text navigation; not identity, composition verification or clinical applicability
matching: Case-insensitive whole-name boundaries; longest alternative first. Offsets index the unchanged source string. No taxonomy, strain, chemical synonym or efficacy inference. Qualifiers and full original text remain available.
dsld: Add LABEL_TITLE_MENTIONS_TOPIC and INGREDIENT_NAME_MENTIONS_TOPIC; retain source occurrence role and existing HAS_DECLARED_TOPIC links. Count unique labels across channels.
natmed: Audit and preserve existing HAS_SOURCE_TOPIC links and pending claim status; no new product applicability.
reddit: Audit and preserve existing literal mention and inherited-thread relations with saved hit provenance; no conversion between channels.
terminology: Audit and preserve reviewed PubChem/RxNorm/MeSH mapping relations; topic-name similarity never creates identity links.
confidence: High only for an observed literal source-field mention, not the presence of active material or a medical fact
unmatched: Remain unlinked under this rule. Alias list is intentionally bounded; no completeness or recall guarantee.
